title: An open purchase order line retyped to another spelling before a rename keeps its typed number
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin (or a default Parts Manager): Part Library & Inventory View, Create & Edit and Delete, and See Financial Data. Data: QAPL-T2 (stocked at both locations) with an open PO line linked to it at Staging Heavy Duty and another at Staging Lethbridge. SR-1 (decided rule, don't file): a line retyped as a case, punctuation or accent variant of its own number counts as re-pointed and does not follow a rename.
custom_steps:
1. Open the open PO at Staging Heavy Duty > edit the QAPL-T2 line's part number to "qapl-t2" > save the PO.
  2. Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-T2 > Part Number "QAPL-T2-RN" > Save.
  3. Reopen the Staging Heavy Duty PO.
  4. Switch to Staging Lethbridge > open the open PO with the QAPL-T2 line.
  5. Restore: rename QAPL-T2-RN back to "QAPL-T2"; set the Heavy Duty PO line back to "QAPL-T2" and save.
custom_expected:
1. The PO saves; the line reads "qapl-t2".
  2. "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." shows while typing; the save succeeds.
  3. The retyped line still reads "qapl-t2" (re-pointed, so it keeps its typed number).
  4. The line still linked to the part reads "QAPL-T2-RN".
  5. The part and both lines read "QAPL-T2" again.
